name: Fruition Venture Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1960, Fruition Ventures
 Ltd is in the business of manufacturing 
and marketing of consumer goods[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
FVL was in the business of trading and manufacturing commodities. It has recently ventured into the manufacturing and marketing of consumer goods. 
The company has done installation of injection moulding machines, and has commenced production of plastic products.

pros: Debtor days have improved from 152 to 36.1 days.
Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 489 days to 92.2 days
cons: Stock is trading at 3.27 times its book value
Company has a low return on equity of -5.41% over last 3 years.
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
